headline: The Family Medicine Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can train clinic staff and check their teach-back, explain a hidden problem or coverage change to patients and families, lead a no-blame near-miss talk, direct an urgent call to emergency services, and answer an auditor and write the day's report in Spanish.

lessons.title: Onboarding a New Medical Assistant to Our Visit Flow
lessons.objective: Teach a new medical assistant the clinic's visit flow step by step and have her explain it back in Spanish.

words.note: Common clinic shorthand for taking all vital signs.
Common US clinic usage; consultorio is the doctor's office.
Ask about them directly; many patients don't count teas or herbs as medicine.
Introduces a result: the reason comes first, then por eso.

words.en: First you take the vital signs, and then you review the medications.
words.es: Primero tomas los signos vitales y luego revisas los medicamentos.
words.note: Informal tú, coworker to coworker.

words.en: Even if the waiting room is full, don't skip the medication list.
words.es: Aunque la sala esté llena, no te saltes la lista de medicamentos.
words.note: Aunque + subjunctive (esté) for a situation that may happen.

words.en: We do it this way because a medication error can be serious.
words.es: Lo hacemos así porque un error de medicación puede ser grave.

words.en: That's why we also ask about supplements and home remedies.
words.es: Por eso también preguntamos por suplementos y remedios caseros.

words.en: After weighing the patient, take him to the exam room.
words.es: Después de pesar al paciente, llévalo al cuarto de examen.

words.en: Can you explain the visit flow to me in your own words?
words.es: ¿Me explicas el flujo de la visita con tus propias palabras?
words.note: Informal.

words.en: What medications are you taking now, including vitamins?
words.es: ¿Qué medicamentos toma usted ahora, incluyendo vitaminas?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: Very good; so what comes next?

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician training the AI, new medical assistant Lucía Herrera, on the clinic's visit flow: walk her through each step with primero, luego and después, give the reasons with porque and por eso, then have her explain the flow back to you.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero la toma de signos, luego la lista de medicamentos, porque..., por eso...)

examples.es: Primero haces la toma de signos y luego confirmas la lista de medicamentos.
examples.en: First you do the vitals check, and then you confirm the medication list.

examples.es: El doctor necesita saber qué toma el paciente; por eso no saltamos ese paso.
examples.en: The doctor needs to know what the patient takes; that's why we don't skip that step.

lessons.title: Why the Clinic Flags Overdue Screenings
lessons.objective: Explain to a community health worker how the care-gap list works and why patients who feel fine still get called.

words.note: A woman is la promotora de salud.
Say it like English 'fit'; it's the stool test done at home.
For a woman: asintomática.

words.en: We call the patient if a test is missing.
words.es: Se llama al paciente si le falta una prueba.
words.note: Impersonal se: no specific person does the action.

words.en: If cancer is detected at an early stage, it's treated better.
words.es: Si el cáncer se detecta en etapa temprana, se trata mejor.

words.en: Feeling fine doesn't mean everything is fine.
words.es: Sentirse bien no quiere decir que todo esté bien.

words.en: Many diseases are silent at first.
words.es: Muchas enfermedades son silenciosas al principio.

words.en: The system flags the patient when the recommended interval passes.
words.es: El sistema marca al paciente cuando pasa el intervalo recomendado.

words.en: Now you explain to me how the list works.
words.es: Ahora explícame tú cómo funciona la lista.
words.note: Informal, to a coworker.

words.en: According to our records, you have an outstanding test.
words.es: Según nuestros registros, usted tiene una prueba pendiente.
words.note: Formal, to the patient on the phone.

words.en: Would you like us to make the appointment today?
words.es: ¿Quiere que le hagamos la cita hoy mismo?
words.note: Formal; querer que + subjunctive (hagamos).

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician, and the AI is promotor Ramiro Quintero: explain how the care-gap list works and why patients who feel fine still get called, using impersonal se and si + present (se llama al paciente si..., si se detecta temprano...), then have him explain it back.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se llama al paciente si falta una prueba; si se detecta temprano, se trata mejor)

examples.es: Se llama al paciente si falta una prueba en su expediente.
examples.en: The patient gets a call if a test is missing from their chart.

examples.es: Si se detecta temprano, se trata mejor y cuesta menos.
examples.en: If it's caught early, it's treated better and costs less.

lessons.title: Coaching an MA on Accurate Blood Pressure Readings
lessons.objective: Coach a new medical assistant through a correct blood pressure technique using clear commands, then check her teach-back.

words.note: Also el manguito; both are understood.
Standard term in Mexico for a BP device.

words.en: Rest the patient's arm at heart level.
words.es: Apóyale el brazo a la altura del corazón.
words.note: Informal command to the MA; le refers to the patient.

words.en: Push up the sleeve; don't take it over clothing.
words.es: Súbele la manga; no la tomes sobre la ropa.
words.note: Here the pronoun refers to the blood pressure. Negative informal commands use no + the subjunctive form.

words.en: Per the protocol, wait 5 minutes and then repeat it.
words.es: Según el protocolo, espera 5 minutos y luego repítela.

words.en: Write it in the chart with the time.
words.es: Anótala en el expediente con la hora.
words.note: Pronoun attaches to affirmative commands; add the accent.

words.en: Check the cuff size; that one is too small for the patient.
words.es: Revisa el tamaño del brazalete; ese le queda chico.

words.en: Please uncross your legs and rest your back.
words.es: Por favor, descruce las piernas y apoye la espalda.
words.note: Formal usted commands, to the patient.

words.en: Relax and don't talk while we take your blood pressure.
words.es: Relájese y no hable mientras le tomamos la presión.
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: Now you explain the steps of the technique to me.
words.es: Ahora explícame tú los pasos de la técnica.

lessons.speaking: You are coaching the AI, new medical assistant Daniela Rojas, through a blood pressure recheck following the clinic's protocol: guide each step with commands like apóyale el brazo, no lo cruces, repítela and anótala, then have her explain the technique back to you.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (apóyale el brazo, no lo cruces, repítela, anótala)

examples.es: Apóyale el brazo en la mesa y no lo dejes colgando.
examples.en: Rest the patient's arm on the table and don't leave it hanging.

examples.es: Repítela después del reposo y anótala junto a la primera.
examples.en: Repeat it after the rest and write it down next to the first one.

lessons.title: Reading the Vaccine Fridge Log Protocol with Staff
lessons.objective: Read the clinic's cold-chain protocol aloud with a nurse and explain what must happen before and after using the fridge.

words.note: Also el refri (informal, Mexico) or la nevera in other countries.
Standard term in Spanish vaccine-storage guidance.
A woman is la coordinadora de vacunas.

words.en: Before opening the fridge, you have to check the log.
words.es: Antes de abrir el refrigerador, hay que revisar el registro.

words.en: According to the protocol, the fridge must be between 36 and 46 °F.
words.es: Según el protocolo, el refrigerador debe estar entre 36 y 46 °F.

words.en: After recording the temperature, we have to notify the coordinator.
words.es: Después de anotar la temperatura, hay que avisar al coordinador.

words.en: We have to label them "Do not use" and keep them in the fridge.
words.es: Hay que marcarlas con "No usar" y dejarlas en el refrigerador.

words.en: Don't use those vaccines until we hear back from the manufacturer.
words.es: No uses esas vacunas hasta tener la respuesta del fabricante.
words.note: Informal, to a coworker.

words.en: What time did you record the last reading?
words.es: ¿A qué hora anotaste la última lectura?

words.en: Let's read the next step of the protocol together.
words.es: Leamos juntos el siguiente paso del protocolo.

words.en: Good morning, I'm calling to report a temperature excursion.
words.es: Buenos días, llamo para reportar una excursión de temperatura.
words.note: Formal, to the manufacturer or health department.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician, and the AI is nurse Felipe Arango: read the clinic's cold-chain protocol aloud together and explain what must happen before and after using the vaccine fridge, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de abrir la nevera hay que revisar el registro; después de anotar, hay que avisar)

examples.es: Antes de sacar cualquier vacuna, hay que confirmar la temperatura en el registro.
examples.en: Before taking out any vaccine, you have to confirm the temperature in the log.

examples.es: Después de llamar al fabricante, hay que anotar lo que nos digan.
examples.en: After calling the manufacturer, we have to write down what they tell us.

lessons.title: Home Visit: The Daughter Mentions Falls He Never Reported
lessons.objective: Get the story of unreported falls from a patient and his daughter, and propose next steps they can agree on.

words.note: Tapete is the usual word in Mexico; alfombra is a larger carpet.
With patients, say: se le baja la presión al pararse.
Patients say: me levanto a orinar de noche.
Patients often say: la pastilla para adelgazar la sangre.

words.en: What were you doing when you fell, Don Ernesto?
words.es: ¿Qué estaba haciendo cuando se cayó, don Ernesto?
words.note: Imperfect for the background action, preterite for the fall. Formal.

words.en: Did you hit your head when you fell?
words.es: ¿Se pegó en la cabeza cuando se cayó?
words.note: Pegarse is the everyday Mexican verb for hitting yourself.

words.en: Were you able to get up on your own, or did someone help you?
words.es: ¿Pudo levantarse solo o alguien lo ayudó?

words.en: Marisol, how many times did you see him fall last month?
words.es: Marisol, ¿cuántas veces lo vio caerse el mes pasado?

words.en: Were you dizzy when you used to get up at night?
words.es: ¿Estaba mareado cuando se levantaba de noche?

words.en: We could request an occupational therapy evaluation at home.
words.es: Podríamos pedir una evaluación de terapia ocupacional en casa.

words.en: Would it be all right to put a night-light in the hallway?
words.es: ¿Le parecería bien poner una luz de noche en el pasillo?
words.note: Conditional softens the proposal. Formal.

words.en: It's not to take away your independence, but to look after you.
words.es: No es para quitarle su independencia, sino para cuidarlo.

lessons.speaking: You are the family physician on a home visit, and the AI is Don Ernesto, 81, with his daughter Marisol: get the story of the falls with preterite and imperfect (se cayó cuando se levantaba), then propose next steps with podríamos and ¿le parecería bien...?

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (se cayó cuando se levantaba de noche; podríamos pedir una evaluación)

examples.es: Se cayó cuando se levantaba de noche para ir al baño.
examples.en: He fell when he was getting up at night to go to the bathroom.

examples.es: Podríamos poner barras de apoyo junto al inodoro.
examples.en: We could put grab bars next to the toilet.

lessons.title: Insurance Won't Cover It: Explaining the Formulary Switch
lessons.objective: Explain a covered inhaler alternative to a worried patient, compare the two, and confirm instructions with the pharmacist.

words.note: Some patients call it la aerocámara.
Patients may also say el disparo or el puf.
La farmacéutica for a woman, el farmacéutico for a man.

words.en: Your insurance doesn't cover the previous inhaler, but there is another option.
words.es: Su seguro no cubre el inhalador anterior, pero hay otra opción.
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: According to the pharmacist, the new one is as effective as the previous one.
words.es: Según la farmacéutica, el nuevo es tan eficaz como el anterior.

words.en: You're going to use it as the new prescription and the label say.
words.es: Lo va a usar como indican la receta nueva y la etiqueta.

words.en: Inés, could you read me the label instructions, please?
words.es: Inés, ¿me lee las instrucciones de la etiqueta, por favor?
words.note: Formal usted with a pharmacist you work with by phone.

words.en: I'll send the new prescription to your pharmacy today.
words.es: Le mandaré la receta nueva a su farmacia hoy mismo.

words.en: Can you tell me back how you're going to use it at home?
words.es: ¿Me repite cómo lo va a usar en casa?

words.en: If you feel more short of breath than before, call us right away.
words.es: Si siente más falta de aire que antes, llámenos enseguida.

words.en: In 2 weeks we're going to check how you're doing with the new one.
words.es: En 2 semanas vamos a revisar cómo le va con el nuevo.

lessons.speaking: You are the family physician, and the AI is pharmacist Inés Guzmán and then your worried patient Rafael Montoya: confirm the label instructions with Inés, then compare the inhalers with más... que and tan... como, and explain the plan with va a and the future.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (va a usarlo igual que antes; este es más barato, pero tan eficaz como el otro según la farmacéutica)

examples.es: Mañana va a recoger el inhalador nuevo en la farmacia.
examples.en: Tomorrow you're going to pick up the new inhaler at the pharmacy.

examples.es: Este es más barato que el otro y, según la farmacéutica, igual de eficaz.
examples.en: This one is cheaper than the other and, according to the pharmacist, just as effective.

lessons.title: Home Health Nurse Calls In with a Weekend of Readings
lessons.objective: Take a fast phone report of weekend readings from a home health nurse, read every number back, and confirm the plan.

words.note: El enfermero a domicilio for a man.
Common in Mexico for a handwritten log of readings.
Patients say: se me bajó el azúcar.

words.en: Beatriz, more slowly, please; I'm going to write everything down.
words.es: Beatriz, más despacio, por favor; voy a anotar todo.

words.note: Say each number back before writing it in the chart.

words.en: What time did you measure the glucose on Sunday?
words.es: ¿A qué hora midió la glucosa el domingo?

words.en: How much did she weigh on Sunday, in pounds?
Fernando, excuse me; first I'll finish with the nurse.
words.es: Fernando, permítame; primero termino con la enfermera.
words.note: Formal and polite way to hold off an interruption.

words.en: Did you measure that number, or does it come from the log?
words.es: ¿Ese número lo midió usted o viene de la bitácora?

words.en: Did you notice the swollen ankles on Saturday or Sunday?
words.es: ¿Notó los tobillos hinchados el sábado o el domingo?

words.en: I'll read everything back to you to confirm.
words.es: Le leo todo de nuevo para confirmar.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinic physician, and the AI is home health nurse Beatriz Ochoa on speakerphone with Doña Amparo's son Fernando: take the weekend report, ask about each day in the preterite (¿cuánto pesó el domingo?), read every number back with repito, and confirm the plan.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (el sábado midió..., el domingo pesó...; repito: ¿ciento ochenta y dos?)

examples.es: El sábado midió la glucosa en ayunas y le salió 182.
examples.en: On Saturday she measured the fasting glucose and got 182.

examples.es: El domingo pesó 164 libras; repito: ¿164?
examples.en: On Sunday she weighed 164 pounds; I repeat: 164?

lessons.title: Refusing to Prescribe for a Brother Who Isn't Here
lessons.objective: Say no to prescribing for an absent relative, explain why kindly, and offer a safe alternative for the brother.

words.note: Common on Spanish pharmacy labels in the US.

words.en: I understand you want to help your brother, Julián.
words.es: Entiendo que quiere ayudar a su hermano, Julián.
words.note: Personal a before su hermano.

words.en: I can't prescribe for someone I haven't evaluated.
words.es: No puedo recetarle a alguien que no he evaluado.

words.en: Please don't pass him your pills; each prescription is personal.
words.es: Por favor, no le pase sus pastillas; cada receta es personal.
words.note: Formal negative command: no le pase.

words.en: I don't recommend that he take them without a medical evaluation.
words.es: No recomiendo que las tome sin una evaluación médica.
words.note: No recomiendo que + subjunctive (tome).

words.en: I understand your frustration; I'm doing this for your brother's safety.
words.es: Entiendo su frustración; lo hago por la seguridad de su hermano.

words.en: What I can do is help you look for options.
words.es: Lo que sí puedo hacer es ayudarle a buscar opciones.

words.en: He should call his primary care doctor to ask for a refill.
words.es: Que llame a su médico de cabecera para pedir un resurtido.
words.note: Que + subjunctive passes a message to someone who isn't here.

words.en: Shall I help you find a virtual appointment or a community clinic?
words.es: ¿Le ayudo a buscar una cita virtual o una clínica comunitaria?

lessons.speaking: You are the family physician, and the AI is Julián Cárdenas at his follow-up: kindly refuse to prescribe for his absent brother, explain why with negative commands (no le dé...) and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, and offer safe options like a cita virtual.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no le dé sus pastillas; no recomiendo que las comparta)

examples.es: No le dé sus pastillas a su hermano.
examples.en: Don't give your pills to your brother.

examples.es: No recomiendo que las comparta con nadie, ni con la familia.
examples.en: I don't recommend that you share them with anyone, not even family.

lessons.title: Feedback After an MA Used a Child as Interpreter
lessons.objective: Give private, respectful feedback to a medical assistant and agree on how to call an interpreter next time.

words.note: Hablar a solas: give feedback away from coworkers and patients.

words.en: Tomás, do you have a few minutes to talk in private?
words.es: Tomás, ¿tienes unos minutos para hablar a solas?
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: I know you did it to help the patient.
words.es: Sé que lo hiciste para ayudar a la paciente.

words.en: I want you to call the interpreter even if the child wants to help.
words.es: Quiero que llames al intérprete aunque el niño quiera ayudar.

words.en: I recommend you request it before going into the room.
words.es: Te recomiendo que lo pidas antes de entrar al cuarto.

words.en: I don't want a child carrying the weight of his mom's results.
words.es: No quiero que un niño cargue con los resultados de su mamá.

words.en: I'd rather we wait for the interpreter, even if it takes a few minutes.
words.es: Prefiero que esperemos al intérprete, aunque tarde unos minutos.

words.en: What do you need to make calling the line easier?
words.es: ¿Qué necesitas para que sea más fácil llamar a la línea?

words.en: Ma'am, we're going to call an interpreter to explain your results to you.
words.es: Señora, vamos a llamar a un intérprete para explicarle sus resultados.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the NP at a school-based health center, and the AI is Tomás Varela, a medical assistant: give him private, respectful feedback on using a child as interpreter and agree on next steps with quiero que and te recomiendo que plus the subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que llames al intérprete; te recomiendo que lo pidas antes)

examples.es: Quiero que llames al intérprete antes de dar resultados.
examples.en: I want you to call the interpreter before giving results.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que pidas el intérprete por video desde el principio.
examples.en: I recommend you request the video interpreter from the start.

lessons.title: Front Desk and Nurse Clash Over Same-Day Slots
lessons.objective: Hear both sides of a staff conflict, report back what each said, and settle on a shared rule for same-day visits.

words.note: Many US clinics also write and say triage.
La recepcionista for a woman, el recepcionista for a man.

words.en: Carmen, tell me what happened from your point of view.
words.es: Carmen, cuéntame qué pasó desde tu punto de vista.
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: Carmen said there were no appointments available that morning.
words.es: Carmen dijo que no había citas disponibles esa mañana.

words.en: Héctor said the patient was having trouble breathing.
words.es: Héctor dijo que al paciente le costaba respirar.

words.en: So you told him to come back tomorrow?
words.es: Entonces, ¿tú le dijiste que regresara mañana?

words.en: You both wanted what was best for the patient.
words.es: Los dos querían lo mejor para el paciente.

words.en: Nobody here is to blame; the communication broke down.
words.es: Nadie aquí tiene la culpa; falló la comunicación.

words.en: From now on, the nurse checks the patient before rescheduling.
words.es: De ahora en adelante, la enfermera revisa al paciente antes de reprogramarlo.

words.en: Are you both OK with saving 2 slots a day for these cases?
words.es: ¿Les parece bien guardar 2 cupos al día para estos casos?
words.note: Ustedes: speaking to both staff members at once.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinic's lead NP, and the AI plays receptionist Carmen and nurse Héctor: hear each version of why a coughing patient was sent home, report back what each said with dijo que plus the imperfect, and agree on a shared same-day rule.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (Carmen dijo que no había citas; Héctor dijo que el paciente tosía mucho)

examples.es: Carmen explicó que la sala estaba llena y que ya era tarde.
examples.en: Carmen explained that the waiting room was full and that it was already late.

examples.es: Héctor dijo que el paciente tosía mucho y estaba pálido.
examples.en: Héctor said the patient was coughing a lot and was pale.

lessons.title: Keeping the Team Going at a Saturday Flu Shot Drive
lessons.objective: Encourage a tired team mid-event, recognize their work, and commit to concrete changes for the rest of the day.

words.note: Common Mexican word; also used for vaccine transport coolers.

words.en: the relief person, the person taking over

words.note: Slightly formal; informally people say algo de comer.

words.en: You're doing great, we're almost done!
words.note: Ustedes: cheering on the whole team.

words.en: I'll open another registration table so the line moves.
words.es: Abriré otra mesa de registro para que avance la fila.

words.en: We'll bring water and something to eat in 10 minutes.
words.es: Traeremos agua y algo de comer en 10 minutos.

words.en: Alma, I'll talk with the families who have questions.
words.es: Alma, yo hablaré con las familias que tienen dudas.

words.en: Noé, rest for 15 minutes; I'll cover your table.
words.es: Noé, descansa 15 minutos; yo cubriré tu mesa.
words.note: Informal: tú with a teammate.

words.en: Thanks to you, we've already vaccinated more than 100 people.
words.es: Gracias a ustedes, ya vacunamos a más de 100 personas.

words.en: Every hour we'll take a short break, I promise you.
words.es: Cada hora haremos una pausa corta, se los prometo.

words.en: Ma'am, I'm happy to explain; what questions do you have about the vaccine?
words.es: Señora, con gusto le explico; ¿qué dudas tiene sobre la vacuna?
words.note: Formal: usted with a parent in line.

lessons.speaking: You are the NP leading a Saturday flu shot drive, and the AI plays promotoras Alma and Noé: recognize their work, cheer them on with phrases like ¡van muy bien, ya casi!, and commit to concrete changes in the future tense (abriré, traeremos).

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (abriré otra mesa, traeremos agua; ¡van muy bien, ya casi!)

examples.es: Abriré otra mesa y pediré otro relevo.
examples.en: I'll open another table and ask for another relief person.

examples.es: A las 2 traeremos comida y tomaremos turnos para descansar.
examples.en: At 2 we'll bring food and take turns resting.

lessons.title: One Asthma Plan, Four Listeners: Grandma to Colleague
lessons.objective: Explain one asthma action plan to four listeners, switching register for each, and check every teach-back.

words.note: Clinical word, good with colleagues and the school nurse.
Everyday word families use for wheezing.

words.en: Doña Celia, I'd like to explain the plan to you calmly.
words.es: Doña Celia, quisiera explicarle el plan con calma.
words.note: Formal: usted with an elder; quisiera softens the request.

words.en: Mateo, can you repeat it to me in your own words?
words.es: Mateo, ¿me lo puedes repetir con tus palabras?
words.note: Informal: tú with a teen.

words.en: Would you mind telling me what you do if Mateo is in the yellow zone?
words.es: ¿Le importaría decirme qué hace si Mateo está en zona amarilla?
words.note: Formal teach-back question.

words.en: The doses are the ones listed in the plan the physician signed.
words.es: Las dosis son las que indica el plan firmado por el médico.

words.en: According to the plan, in the red zone you need to call 911.
words.es: Según el plan, en zona roja hay que llamar al 911.

words.en: Mrs. Ortega, I'll send you the signed plan today.
words.es: Sra. Ortega, le envío el plan firmado hoy mismo.
words.note: Formal: usted with the school nurse by phone.

words.en: Mateo, tell the school nurse if your chest feels tight.
words.es: Mateo, avísale a la enfermera escolar si sientes el pecho apretado.

words.en: Iván, could you check whether I missed anything?
words.es: Iván, ¿podrías revisar si se me pasó algo?
words.note: Informal but polite: tú with a fellow NP.

lessons.speaking: You are the NP, and the AI plays Doña Celia, her grandson Mateo, school nurse Sra. Ortega and NP Iván Prado: explain the signed asthma plan to each, switching usted and tú, using softeners like quisiera explicarle and ¿me lo puedes repetir?, and check each teach-back.

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera explicarle..., ¿me lo puedes repetir?, ¿le importaría...?)

examples.es: Doña Celia, quisiera explicarle cada zona del plan.
examples.en: Doña Celia, I'd like to explain each zone of the plan to you.

examples.es: Mateo, ¿me puedes enseñar qué haces en la zona amarilla?
examples.en: Mateo, can you show me what you do in the yellow zone?

lessons.title: Patient Faints After a Blood Draw and Hits His Head
lessons.objective: Rebuild the timeline of a fainting incident with staff and the patient, then complete the incident report in Spanish.

words.note: For a man, say el flebotomista.
Everyday Mexican word; patients and families use it often.

words.en: What time exactly did Kevin faint?
words.es: ¿A qué hora exactamente se desmayó Kevin?

words.en: Yesenia, what happened first, the dizziness or the fainting?
words.es: Yesenia, ¿qué pasó primero, el mareo o el desmayo?
words.note: Informal tú is fine between coworkers.

words.es: A las 9:10 terminó la extracción de sangre.

words.en: 2 minutes later, he stood up and fell.
words.es: 2 minutos después, se levantó y se cayó.

words.note: Formal, to the girlfriend.

words.en: Kevin, did you pass out or do you remember the fall?
words.es: Kevin, ¿perdió el conocimiento o recuerda la caída?
words.note: Formal usted with the patient.

words.en: Yesenia, did you put the cold compress on him right away?
words.es: Yesenia, ¿le pusiste la compresa fría enseguida?

words.en: Let's write in the report what each witness saw.
words.es: Anotemos en el reporte lo que vio cada testigo.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician, and the AI is phlebotomist Yesenia and then Kevin's girlfriend: ask each what happened, rebuild one timeline with a las…, enseguida, dos minutos después and mientras tanto, then read the incident report back to confirm it.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las nueve y diez, enseguida, dos minutos después, mientras tanto)

examples.es: A las 9:10, Yesenia terminó la extracción y Kevin se levantó.
examples.en: At 9:10, Yesenia finished the draw and Kevin stood up.

examples.es: Mientras tanto, su novia buscaba ayuda en la recepción.
examples.en: Meanwhile, his girlfriend was looking for help at the front desk.

lessons.title: Same Name, Wrong Chart: A Near-Miss Vaccine Huddle
lessons.objective: Lead a no-blame huddle about a near-miss vaccine error and agree on what the team will do differently.

words.note: For a man, say el asistente médico.
Takes the present tense for a past event: por poco se la pone = she almost gave it to her.

words.en: Rosa, this huddle isn't about finding someone to blame.
words.es: Rosa, esta junta no es para buscar culpables.
words.note: Informal tú with a coworker.

words.en: We almost vaccinated the wrong patient; the check saved us.
words.es: Casi vacunamos a la paciente equivocada; la verificación nos salvó.

words.en: If you hadn't asked for the two identifiers, it could have happened.
words.es: Si no hubieras pedido los dos identificadores, podría haber pasado.

words.en: What happened in the system that opened the other chart?
words.es: ¿Qué pasó en el sistema para que se abriera el otro expediente?

words.en: Thank you for reporting it; that's how we all learn.
words.es: Gracias por reportarlo; así aprendemos todos.

words.en: What can we change so it doesn't happen again?
words.es: ¿Qué podemos cambiar para que no vuelva a pasar?

words.en: Starting today, the order is confirmed with the two identifiers.
words.es: A partir de hoy, la orden se confirma con los dos identificadores.

words.en: Mrs. López, could you tell me your full name and date of birth?
words.es: Señora López, ¿me dice su nombre completo y fecha de nacimiento?
words.note: Formal usted with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician leading the morning huddle, and the AI is medical assistant Rosa Delgado: reassure her, talk through the near miss with por poco, casi and si no hubiera…, podría haber pasado, and agree with the team on one change.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco se la pone; si no hubiera revisado la fecha de nacimiento, podría haber pasado)

examples.es: Por poco le pone la vacuna a la otra María José.
examples.en: She almost gave the vaccine to the other María José.

examples.es: Si Rosa no hubiera revisado la fecha de nacimiento, podría haber pasado.
examples.en: If Rosa hadn't checked the date of birth, it could have happened.

lessons.title: Phone Call: Her Father's Speech Is Suddenly Slurred
lessons.objective: Recognize an emergency on the phone and give a caller short, clear instructions to call 911 now.

words.note: Habla is feminine but takes el: el habla arrastrada.
Callers often say se le durmió el brazo instead.

words.en: Mrs. Arce, this can't wait for an appointment.
words.es: Señora Arce, esto no puede esperar a una cita.
words.note: Formal usted with the caller.

words.en: Hang up and dial 911 right now.
words.es: Cuelgue y marque el 911 ahora mismo.

words.en: If you call now, the ambulance will get there soon.
words.es: Si llama ahora, la ambulancia llegará pronto.

words.en: Is your father awake and breathing well?
words.es: ¿Su papá está despierto y respira bien?

words.en: Write down the time he started talking like this.
words.es: Anote la hora en que empezó a hablar así.

words.en: Open the front door for the paramedics.
words.es: Abra la puerta de la casa para los paramédicos.

words.en: Give the paramedics the list of his medications.
words.es: Dele a los paramédicos la lista de sus medicamentos.

words.en: When you know which hospital they're taking him to, please call us.
words.es: Cuando sepa a qué hospital lo llevan, llámenos, por favor.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician answering the clinic line, and the AI is Silvia Arce, who wants an appointment for her father: ask a few short questions, explain why she must call 911 now, and use commands like cuelgue y marque el 911 and anote la hora, plus si llama ahora, llegarán pronto.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short phone commands (si llama ahora, llegarán pronto; cuelgue y marque el 911; anote la hora)

examples.es: Si cuelga y marca el 911 ahora, la ayuda llegará más rápido.
examples.en: If you hang up and dial 911 now, help will arrive faster.

examples.es: Si su papá deja de responder, el 911 le dirá qué hacer.
examples.en: If your father stops responding, 911 will tell you what to do.

lessons.title: Payer Auditor Reviews Charts and Privacy Practices
lessons.objective: Answer a payer auditor formally about how consent, record release, and diabetes measures are documented.

words.note: For a man, say el auditor.

words.en: Ms. Medina, I'm glad to explain our process.
words.es: Licenciada Medina, con gusto le explico nuestro proceso.
words.note: Formal. Licenciada is a common Mexican title for a woman with a university degree.

words.en: Identity is verified with 2 identifiers at every visit.
words.es: Se verifica la identidad con 2 identificadores en cada visita.

words.en: The consent is scanned and filed in the electronic health record.
words.es: El consentimiento se escanea y se archiva en el expediente electrónico.

words.en: The hemoglobin A1c is recorded in a structured field.
words.es: La hemoglobina A1c se registra en un campo estructurado.

words.en: Under our policy, information is released only with a signed authorization.
words.es: Según nuestra política, se divulga información solo con autorización firmada.

words.en: You're right, this authorization is missing the signature date.
words.es: Tiene razón, a esta autorización le falta la fecha de firma.

words.en: We'll document it as a finding and send you a corrective action plan.
words.es: Lo documentaremos como hallazgo y le enviaremos un plan correctivo.

words.en: Would you also like to review the access log?
words.es: ¿Desea revisar también el registro de accesos?
words.note: Formal; desea is more formal than quiere.

lessons.speaking: You are the practice's medical director, and the AI is payer auditor Lic. Patricia Medina: answer her questions formally about how consent, record release and diabetes measures are documented, using passive se (se verifica la identidad, se archiva, se registra según la política).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se verifica la identidad, se archiva el consentimiento, se registra según la política)

examples.es: Se verifica la identidad antes de entregar cualquier expediente.
examples.en: Identity is verified before any record is released.

examples.es: Cada autorización se revisa y se archiva el mismo día.
examples.en: Each authorization is reviewed and filed the same day.

lessons.title: Writing a Plain-Spanish After-Visit Summary
lessons.objective: Write a clear after-visit summary in Spanish: findings, plan, warning signs, and follow-up.

words.note: Write timing and amount only as the prescription label states them.
Common pharmacy label wording; copy the label's exact timing into the summary.
Say the letters the Spanish way: te-ese-hache.
Written connector; in speech people often use simpler words for 'so'.
Always followed by the subjunctive.

words.en: During the video call, we talked about your tiredness and dry skin.
words.es: Durante la videollamada, hablamos de su cansancio y su piel reseca.
words.note: Formal usted for the patient.

words.en: Your blood test showed that your thyroid makes too little hormone.
words.es: Su análisis de sangre mostró que la tiroides produce poca hormona.

words.en: Therefore, you will take levothyroxine as the label directs.
words.es: Por lo tanto, tomará levotiroxina como indica la etiqueta.

words.en: Also, ask at the pharmacy before taking antacids or iron.
words.es: Además, pregunte en la farmacia antes de tomar antiácidos o hierro.

words.en: If you feel palpitations or chest pain, call us.
words.es: En caso de que sienta palpitaciones o dolor de pecho, llámenos.

words.en: As agreed, in 6 weeks we will do a follow-up test.
words.es: Según lo acordado, en 6 semanas le haremos una prueba de control.

words.en: Diego, please read this summary to your mom calmly.
words.es: Diego, por favor léele este resumen a tu mamá con calma.
words.note: Informal tú for the teenage son.

words.en: In closing, call the clinic if you have any questions.
words.es: Para concluir, llame a la clínica si tiene cualquier duda.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician, and the AI is Diego, Leticia Bravo's son, reading your summary aloud: write and read out the after-visit summary (findings, plan per the prescription label, warning signs, follow-up) using además, por lo tanto, en caso de que and para concluir.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (además, por lo tanto, en caso de que, para concluir)

examples.es: Además, notamos cansancio y piel reseca desde hace meses.
examples.en: In addition, we noted tiredness and dry skin for several months.

examples.es: En caso de que tenga palpitaciones, llame a la clínica enseguida.
examples.en: If you have palpitations, call the clinic right away.

lessons.title: Portal Messages and Callbacks: Results and Reschedules
lessons.objective: Answer patient portal messages and return calls politely, verifying identity before sharing any results.

words.note: Per most clinic policies, leave only a callback request there, never results.
Warm, polite phone formula in Mexican Spanish.

words.en: Good afternoon, I'm calling from the clinic to return your call.
words.es: Buenas tardes, le hablo de la clínica para regresarle la llamada.
words.note: Formal; 'return a call' this way is common in Mexico and the US.

words.en: Could you confirm your full name and date of birth?
words.es: ¿Podría confirmarme su nombre completo y fecha de nacimiento?
words.note: Formal; the conditional softens the request.

words.en: Nayeli, thank you for your message; I've reviewed your results.
words.es: Nayeli, gracias por su mensaje; ya revisé sus resultados.

words.en: I'm sorry, ma'am, your name isn't on the release form.
words.es: Lo siento, señora, su nombre no aparece en la autorización.

words.en: Without your husband's authorization, I can't share his results.
words.es: Sin la autorización de su esposo, no puedo compartir sus resultados.

words.en: I would appreciate it if Mr. Villalobos called us directly.
words.es: Le agradecería que el señor Villalobos nos llamara directamente.
words.note: This polite formula takes the past subjunctive.

words.en: Would you like to move your appointment to Thursday morning?
words.es: ¿Le gustaría cambiar su cita para el jueves por la mañana?

words.en: If you prefer, I could send you a secure message through the portal.
words.es: Si prefiere, podría enviarle un mensaje seguro por el portal.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician, and the AI is Nayeli Fuentes, then the wife of Óscar Villalobos: answer the portal message and return the call, verifying identity before sharing any results, using ¿podría confirmarme…? and le agradecería que…

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿podría confirmarme su fecha de nacimiento?, le agradecería que...)

examples.es: ¿Podría confirmarme su fecha de nacimiento, por favor?
examples.en: Could you confirm your date of birth for me, please?

examples.es: Le agradecería que su esposo firmara la autorización en la clínica.
examples.en: I would appreciate it if your husband signed the release at the clinic.

lessons.title: Post-Hospital Visit: Reviewing the Plan Together
lessons.objective: Review a discharge plan with a patient and spouse, set clear conditions for calling, and confirm their teach-back.

words.note: Also written with an accent (cardíaca); both are correct.
Patients often call it 'the water pill' (la pastilla del agua).
The exact amount comes from the discharge orders, not from memory.
For a future event it takes the subjunctive.
Meaning 'as long as', it takes the subjunctive.

words.en: Let's compare the discharge sheet with each bottle, one by one.
words.es: Comparemos la hoja de alta con cada frasco, uno por uno.

words.en: Don't change anything until we confirm with the cardiologist.
words.es: No cambie nada hasta que confirmemos con el cardiólogo.
words.note: Formal. Future point after 'until' takes the subjunctive.

words.en: Whenever you weigh yourself, do it before breakfast.
words.es: Siempre que se pese, hágalo antes de desayunar.

words.en: If you gain more weight than the sheet indicates, call us.
words.es: Si sube de peso más de lo indicado en la hoja, llámenos.

words.en: Mrs. Teresa, call us as soon as you notice his legs are more swollen.
words.es: Doña Teresa, llámenos en cuanto note las piernas más hinchadas.
words.note: Doña plus first name is respectful and warm.

words.en: If I were you, I would bring all the bottles to every appointment.
words.es: Si yo fuera usted, traería todos los frascos a cada cita.

words.en: Don Aurelio, can you explain in your own words when you would call us?
words.es: Don Aurelio, ¿me explica con sus palabras cuándo nos llamaría?

words.en: Mrs. Teresa, what would you do if he were more short of breath?
words.es: Doña Teresa, ¿qué haría usted si él tuviera más falta de aire?

lessons.speaking: You are the family physician, and the AI is Don Aurelio and his wife Teresa: compare the discharge sheet with the bottles they brought, set when to call using siempre que, en cuanto and the conditional (¿qué haría si…?), and confirm their teach-back.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (siempre que se pese cada mañana; llame en cuanto suba de peso según las instrucciones del cardiólogo)

examples.es: Puede seguir con su caminata siempre que no le falte el aire.
examples.en: You can keep up your walk as long as you don't get short of breath.

examples.es: Llámenos en cuanto el peso suba más de lo que indica la hoja de alta.
examples.en: Call us as soon as your weight goes up more than the discharge sheet indicates.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Short-Staffed Monday at a Community Clinic
lessons.objective: Run a full hard clinic day in Spanish: train, explain, escalate, answer an auditor, and dictate the day's report.

words.note: Common in Mexico; US pharmacies also say 'backorder' as a loanword.
Use the feminine form (la revisora) for a woman.

words.en: Today 2 people are out, so we'll reorganize the tasks.
words.es: Hoy faltan 2 personas, así que reorganizaremos las tareas.

words.en: Gabriel, watch me once and then do it yourself.
words.es: Gabriel, obsérvame una vez y después hazlo tú solo.
words.note: Informal tú commands with a coworker.

words.en: Is that clear, or do you want us to go over it together?
words.es: ¿Te quedó claro, o quieres que lo repasemos juntos?
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Mrs. Paz, there's a shortage; I'll look for an alternate pharmacy.
words.es: Señora Paz, hay desabasto; voy a buscar una farmacia alterna.
words.note: Formal usted with the patient.

words.en: Please don't stop the medication without checking with me first.
words.es: Le pido que no suspenda el medicamento sin consultarme primero.

words.en: If we hadn't verified it, the error would have reached the patient.
words.es: Si no lo hubiéramos verificado, el error habría llegado al paciente.

words.en: Mr. Benítez, the event was documented and the patient was notified.
words.es: Sr. Benítez, se documentó el evento y se avisó a la paciente.
words.note: Formal; the passive keeps the report neutral.

words.en: In summary, the day ended with no harm to any patient.
words.es: En resumen, el día terminó sin daños a ningún paciente.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician running the day, and the AI is Gabriel, Elena Paz and Sr. Benítez in turn: train Gabriel with tú commands, explain the backorder to Elena with usted, talk through the near miss, answer Sr. Benítez with passive se, then dictate the report using connectors.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar

examples.es: Gabriel, si tienes dudas, pregúntame antes de llamar a la paciente.
examples.en: Gabriel, if you have questions, ask me before calling the patient.

examples.es: Se habló con la farmacia y se le avisó a la señora Paz.
examples.en: The pharmacy was contacted and Mrs. Paz was notified.
